title: Nice app
body:
Yeah, this is a really nice app. The best part is that it not only helps you build good habits but also supports breaking bad ones, which I think is a great feature.

However, I’ve noticed some issues:
1. The app doesn’t work properly with calendar notifications. If I make any changes in the calendar, instead of editing the existing task, it creates a new one with the same name. This leads to duplicates, and I have to go into the calendar and manually delete them, which is frustrating.
2. When I want to check my weekly report, I get a notification every week. But when I click on it, instead of taking me directly to my weekly progress, it just opens the app and shows all my tasks. It’s inconvenient to navigate through tabs every time just to see my progress. I only want a quick way to view my weekly progress without extra steps.

Suggestion: if they can create a board like Apple screen where they are showing every detail like how a user spending time on different apps and it is also very welcoming feature if they can show this progress as a widget so I can see that on my lock screen (quick glance).

body:
Love the feature that allows you to time your habit sessions from within the app. The analytics are very insightful. I have decided to go for the lifetime subscription. 
A few OFIs:
1. Timer sessions cannot be interrupted midway to log a session based on the expended time of the timer.
2. Some settings are reset on their own, eg., the Times of Day setting. 
3. Better Siri Shortcuts can add multifold utility to the app. Eg., if I wanted to run a Siri shortcut to log session, I should have the flexibility to carry out some customisations to the shortcut block.
